title: Sensor reading
description: S-1. What GET /v1/reading returns. Signed per S-8; the signing string is defined in ../signing.js and covers lot_id, available, capacity, as_of, and nonce.

available.description: S-7 constrains this to [0, capacity] under normal operation. It is deliberately NOT constrained here: the wrong fault mode must be able to produce an out-of-range value, and C-5 requires the collector to reject it at the boundary rather than the schema silently making that case unreachable.

status.description: S-4. The sensor's assessment of itself. There is deliberately no 'offline' value: if it can answer, it is not offline. Reachability is derived by the consumer (C-4), never reported.

as_of.description: S-2. When the count was taken, not when the request was served. Milliseconds and Z are required because the value is signed and two spellings are two different signing strings.

age_ms.description: S-3. Time since the count was taken, from a monotonic source. N-3 computes staleness from this and not from as_of, so that a wrong clock cannot make old data look fresh.
